verdict.rationale: Docs and GitHub README confirm Khoj supports chat models from OpenAI, Anthropic (claude), Google (gemini), local/Ollama models, and any LiteLLM-wrapped provider (which includes OpenRouter), and agents can be configured with distinct chat models/personas (khoj-gh-1, khoj-gh-2, khoj-docs-9, khoj-docs-10, khoj-docs-12, khoj-docs-26). This covers per-agent model switching directly as documented.  Missing for 10: explicit mention of OpenRouter by name, independent/hands-on confirmation of switching models per single conversation (vs. per agent), and current community verification post the older HN threads that only saw OpenAI support.
